title: Review of c02's FCH chemoton: on fresh seed 5 the feed-cut collapse replicates, but no vesicle carries the catalyst; K sits on one open strip (Weak)
summary: Re-ran world.py and world_starve.py unchanged on fresh seed 5 (192^2, T=600), with c02's totals.py and chan.py. From noise, bilayer worms, rods, a ring and small trimers form by t~50 and persist. The catalyst K ends up on one open bilayer strip (purple, with a dark precursor-depletion halo), while the ring and the other rods carry no K; labkit radial: K rim/core 0.54, 0/36 individuals membrane-like, u membrane-like only for the ring. Total amphiphile: fed settles at ~2000 by t=600; feed cut at t=300 (identical before) falls to 323, K total 1400 vs 215. So E at the population level replicates (and holds largely by construction, as the author notes), but the claim's individuals, catalyst-bearing vesicles with a K layer on the bilayer, do not appear on this seed; it looks like the author's seed 1.

observations.I: rerun/seed5/sheet.png t=51-600: discrete bilayer rods, a ring and trimers persist
observations.E: totals_s5.png: amphiphile fed ~2000 vs feed-cut 323 at t=600 (branched at t=300)

seeds_run.result: partial: E replicates at population level; no K-bearing vesicle, K layer absent (K rim/core 0.54)

controls_run.E: rerun_starve/seed5 (precursor feed off at t=300, identical before)

verdicts.limitation: B is claimed for vesicles carrying K on their bilayer; on this seed the only K-bearing body is an open strip, and the K-free ring and rods persist anyway, so persistence is not tied to carrying the catalyst here. E is by construction (amphiphile made only by K from P, decaying at kap). One fresh seed; I did not re-run noK or nogate.
